metadata.title: Email Records
metadata.description: Defines trust properties required to treat email as an institutional record subject to retention, disposition, and legal obligations. This pattern addresses classification, legal holds, auditability, and defensibility, and does not address phishing, identity spoofing, or data loss prevention.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for managing email as an institutional record subject to retention, disposition, and legal obligations.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Email archiving systems, retention controls, eDiscovery tooling, and records management platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing retention, disposition, and evidentiary integrity of email communications.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Email records assume baseline delivery, identity binding, and accountability exist.

metadata.remarks: Email Records defines trust properties required to treat email as an institutional record rather than transient communication. This pattern addresses retention classification, legal holds, auditability, and defensibility, and does not address phishing, identity spoofing, or data loss prevention.

components.title: Email Record Classification
components.description: Determines when email content constitutes an institutional record subject to governance.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection of sensitive information via retained email records.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and record identification to support accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email records are identified and managed in accordance with records management requirements.
Policies define which email communications constitute institutional records.

components.title: Retention and Disposition Control
components.description: Ensures email records are retained and disposed of in accordance with policy and legal requirements.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized deletion or destruction of email records.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle management controls to enforce record retention and deletion.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email records are retained for periods consistent with legal and institutional requirements.
Disposition mechanisms prevent unauthorized removal of required records.

components.title: Legal Hold and eDiscovery Support
components.description: Supports preservation and production of email records under legal or regulatory obligation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Data manipulation or tampering with stored records.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Integrity protection and auditability of retained records.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity mechanisms protect email records against unauthorized modification.
Audit review supports verification of record preservation and production.
